N01_N10_scope: paired full-run GT-aligned outcomes under per-camera global one-to-one assignment; observational, not a single-action causal intervention
component_success_rule: both AssA and HOTA exceed same GMT OFF, no unsupported or GT-dependent online decision
match_horizon_selection: if MATCH-only below GMT, video01 full-future-32 MATCH events where frozen OFF-label best action differs from OFF committed action; evenly spaced 32 ranks by sorted(frame,view,row), fallback evenly spaced all MATCH if none; selection fixed before H16/H32 outcomes
memory_horizon_selection: video06 full-future-32 MEMORY events, evenly spaced 64 ranks by sorted(frame,view,row); use all selected frames/full source event maps; no outcome-dependent selection
scope: frozen policy diagnosis before any retraining
train_reactivation_selection: exclude held-out video01; metadata-only choose smallest complete-video set by descending event count then video ID, target >=200 train and >=50 val events, at most 5 TRAIN-source videos total; unresolved legacy traces are coverage-only, never canonical labels
